title: Web App Factory – Graphing Calculator Demo
overview: A walkthrough demo showing how to use the Web App Factory to generate a graphing calculator web application, update it with a dark theme, and review usage costs.

finalStructure.description: Intro billboard: 'Web App Factory' title card with fade-in-from-black.
Introduction: Explain the Web App Factory, enter project idea ('graphing calculator'), configure models.
Launch pipeline: Navigate to pipeline, explain the build step, describe project plan generation.
Project plan visible: Show 5 tasks, explain execution and graph updates.
Time-compressed: Building project (speed ramp, overlay 'Building project...').
Review task graph and individual tasks, explain foundational documents and core logic.
Time-compressed: Core logic implementation and UI finalization (overlays).
Implementation complete: Review readme, mention download zip, explain Git support.
Error acknowledgment and Git save confirmation.
Launch app: Show graphing calculator, test various formulas (sin(x), combinations).
Request dark theme update: Navigate to updater, type request, run update.
Update results: Refresh calculator, show theme button working.
Wrap-up: Summarize the Web App Factory workflow, show usage cost (11 cents), closing remarks.
Outro billboard: 'Thanks for Watching!' card with fade-to-black.
